Name: (CP) Fio's Spring Easter Egg and Bunny
Author: PocoFio
Description:
[b][size=4][u]Features[/u][/size][/b]
[size=4][b]🥚Coop Eggs to Easter Eggs[/b][/size]
Each type of coop egg turns into Easter eggs with random color everyday.
4 random colors [size=1](blue, orange, pink, green)[/size]
5 size variants [size=1]([/size][size=1]small, large, reverse, massive, basket)[/size]
[i]Note: Different types of eggs might occasionally share the exact same color. [/i][i]But don't worry, they are still different items in your inventory![/i]

[b][size=4]🤎Rabbit Foot to Choco Bunny[/size][/b]
Rabbit foot turn into foil-wrapped chocolate bunnies. It's a delightful gift that EVERYONE loves.
2 random foiled [size=1](gold, silver)[/size]
7 random ribbons [size=1](blue, orange, pink, green, aqua, red, purple)[/size]

[b][size=4]🐰Coop Animals to Easter Bunny[/size][/b]
All vanilla coop animals turn into Easter bunnies.
Don't worry, they even have swim rings to float on water safely!
5 random colors [size=1](pink, blue, green, yellow, white)[/size]
[i]Note: this feature only affects on adult animals.[/i]

[b][size=4]⚙️Custom Settings [/size][/b]
Features above could toggle separately and you can decide when they are active. 
3 time periods [size=1](Whole spring, Spring 1-13, on Egg Festival day)[/size]

[color=#ff00ff][size=4]1.0.3 update[/size]  add new farm animal, products and decor[/color]
[size=4][b]Add New Farm Animal: [/b][/size][b][size=4]Colored Egg Bunny[/size][/b] [size=2](5 random skins, 8000 G, live in Coop)[/size]
[size=3]I highly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar - Custom Animal Shops Framework[/url] if you want to select specific skin color.[/size]

[b][size=4]Animal Products[/size][/b] 
To save your storage space, all Colored Egg Bunnies drop products with customized colors you set in config.
Details:
[spoiler][size=3][b]Colored Egg[/b][/size]
[size=2]min friendship: 0[/size]
[size=2]produce chance: 100% [size=2](If none of the following products are produced)[/size][/size]

[b]Large Colored Egg[/b]
min friendship: 200
produce chance: 50% [size=2](If Massive Colored Egg or Choco Bunny is not produced)[/size]

[b]Reverse Colored Egg[/b]
min friendship: 200
produce chance: 50% [size=2](If Large Colored Egg, Massive Colored Egg or Choco Bunny is not produced )[/size]

[b]Massive Colored Egg[/b]
min friendship: 400
produce chance: 40%

[b]Deluxe Products: [/b][b]Choco Bunny [/b]
min friendship: 200
produce chance: 25% (Base on vanilla deluxe product rules)[/spoiler]

Gift Taste:
[spoiler]Colored Eggs: Same as vanilla eggs, but Emily, Jas, and Vincent [b]like[/b] them.
Choco Bunny: Universal Love[/spoiler]

[b][size=4]Artisan Goods[/size][/b]
All colored eggs can be used to make Mayonnaise, just like vanilla eggs.
[b]Small[/b]: [size=2]Regular quality Mayonnaise[/size]
[b]Large and Reverse[/b]: [size=2]Gold-quality Mayonnaise[/size]
[b]Massive[/b]: [size=2]10 Mayonnaise with a quality equal to the Massive Colored Egg used (same as Ostrich Egg).[/size]

[b][size=4]Cooking Recipes[/size][/b]
Chocolate Cake required Choco Bunny[size=2] (true, false)[/size]

[b]Lucky Hot Chocolate[/b]
Buffs:[size=2] Luck+2, Speed+1 (3 mins)[/size]
Ingredients: [size=2]Any Milk (2), Choco Bunny (1)[/size]

[b]Cherry Hot Chocolate[/b]
Buffs: [size=2]Luck+1, Magnetic Radius+32, Speed+1 (3 mins) [/size]
Ingredients: [size=2]Any Milk (1), [/size][size=2]Cherry (1), [/size][size=2]Choco Bunny (1)[/size]

[b]Orange Hot Chocolate[/b]
Buffs: [size=2]Luck+1, Max Stamina+50, Speed+1 (3 mins) [/size]
Ingredients: [size=2]Any Milk (1), Sugar (1), [/size][size=2]Orange (1), [/size][size=2]Choco Bunny (1)[/size]

[b]Ginger Hot Chocolate[/b]
Buffs: [size=2]Luck+1, Defense+2, Speed+1 (3 mins) [/size]
Ingredients: [size=2]Any Milk (1), Honey (1), [/size][size=2]Ginger (1), Choco Bunny (1)[/size]
[size=2]
[i]Note: All Hot Chocolate gift tastes are based on the gift tastes of vanilla Chocolate Cake.[/i][/size]

[size=4][b]Variant as Crafting Decorations[/b][/size]
Want more than just the customized product colors?
Don't worry! You can craft every color variant to decorate your farm or just satisfy your collecting habits. All decorations can be placed on the ground or displayed on table.
(Included 4 color variants for each type of colored egg, 1 colored egg basket, and 14 variants for Choco Bunny)
